load_inference_model: load a PyTorch inference model from a checkpoint file with optional config overrides and EMA support
load_tasks: load a list of Task objects from a checkpoint file using hydra instantiation
get_backbone_class_from_checkpoint: extract the backbone model class from a checkpoint's config using the registry
update_configs: recursively merge a new config dictionary into an original config and return the updated copy
tf32_context_manager: use a context manager to temporarily enable TF32 precision for CUDA matmul and cuDNN operations
